content.text: For each of the first three images, a 2D point coordinate is given that corresponds to the same semantically meaningful location for each image. Image point coordinates are in [y, x] format, where y is the vertical axis, x is the horizontal axis; their values are normalized from 0 to 1000, where [0 0] is the top left, [1000 1000] is the bottom right. For the last image, which of the following coordinates most closely match the image->coordinate correspondence from the first three images? Choices:  A. (688 291). B. (283 580) . C. (348 205). D. (482 453). Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
